items: [format_amount] input is thousandths; output has exactly two decimals
[format_amount] rounding is half away from zero, for negatives too
[format_amount] rounding happens before grouping, so a carry can add a group (`999.995` to `1,000.00`)
[format_amount] the sign is decided after rounding: a result of zero has no `-`
[format_amount] negative results have a leading `-` before the digits
[Edge cases] `i64::MIN` and `i64::MAX` format without panic (wider arithmetic or equivalent)
[Edge cases] amounts under one unit have a leading `0` (`0.01`)
